metadata.compatibility: controller uses bundled Python 3.13; task tmux shells restore the image PATH/Python/library environment; incompatible image tmux falls back to tmux 3.4 requiring at most glibc 2.28
metadata.completion_contract: always export a valid trajectory after normal Agent return; on a supervised timeout or Agent error export partial trajectory when available so the failure remains diagnosable
metadata.context_headroom_contract: keep the model's real 262144-token registration and trigger Harbor summarization with 65536 estimated tokens free, protecting against custom-model tokenizer undercount and output headroom exhaustion
metadata.deadline_contract: run Terminus as a supervised child process; terminate the child process group 60 seconds before the platform Agent deadline so Harness can preserve artifacts and return before the outer runner kill
metadata.gateway_retry_contract: six jittered exponential retries per Terminus request, with LiteLLM nested retries disabled
metadata.inference_contract: temperature=1.0, top_p=0.95, top_k=50, separate_reasoning=true, reasoning_effort=max, interleaved_thinking=true, model_context_limit=262144, proactive_summarization_threshold=65536, no artificial max_turns
metadata.json_response_contract: TERMINUS_FORCE_JSON_OBJECT=true adds OpenAI response_format=json_object for models whose serving chat template otherwise emits non-Terminus tool-call markup; disabled by default
metadata.material_localization_contract: package application code as one archive; retry and localize Python, dependencies, application, and query before imports while retaining arca_envd for shared reward
metadata.provider_contract: ANTHROPIC_* model registry variables select LiteLLM anthropic provider and add the EnvArena Authorization bearer header; explicit LLM_* or OPENAI_* variables select OpenAI
metadata.service_lifecycle: the final Terminus tmux session is retained until Reward so task-started services remain reachable
metadata.tmux_selection_contract: feature-probe new-session -e on an isolated socket; use packaged tmux when the image binary lacks required environment support
metadata.workspace_contract: prefer authoritative ARENA_AGENT_WORKDIR for image Envs; fall back to ARENA_WORKSPACE for files Envs
metadata.change: 1.0.0: identical to terminus-2-tb21@1.0.12 (same runner, python, site-packages, tmux, env, resource_spec, ttl) except harbor/llms/lite_llm.py: chat completions are requested with stream=True and reassembled with litellm.stream_chunk_builder, so long xhigh generations keep bytes flowing and no longer hit the ~900s sandbox egress cutoff (502 from :7002). TERMINUS_STREAM=false restores the non-streaming call.
metadata.streaming_contract: stream=True + stream_options.include_usage; response reassembled to the same ModelResponse (content, reasoning_content, usage, finish_reason)
